#chrome.runtime

The extension's own facts, its messages and its ports (src/page/ext_api.odin, ext_router.odin, ext_tabs.odin). An offscreen document has this namespace only; a content script has its messages, its ports and its own facts.

Gate: no permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen. Source: api/ext_runtime.widl.

#Methods and properties

MemberResultStatusGate
idstringrealmno permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen, ContentThe extension's id.
lastErrorobjectrealmno permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen, ContentThe error of the call whose callback runs, else undefined. One left unread is logged.
getURL(string path)stringrealmno permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen, ContentThe absolute URL of a file of the extension.
getManifest()objectrealmno permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen, ContentThe manifest, its MSG_* replaced.
connect(optional string extensionId, optional ConnectInfo connectInfo)Portrealmno permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen, ContentA port to the extension's contexts that listen to onConnect (another extension: none).
sendMessage(optional string extensionId, any message, optional MessageOptions options)anyhostno permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Offscreen, ContentTo every page and the background of the extension, not the sender and not the content scripts. The first answer wins; with no receiver, "Could not establish connection. Receiving end does not exist.".
getPlatformInfo()PlatformInfohost
setUninstallURL(optional string url)voidhostAccepted; no page opens when the extension is removed.
getContexts(ContextFilter filter)ExtensionContext[]hostThe extension's contexts as the browser knows them (the background only while it runs).
reload()voidhostThe package is read again; every context of the extension closes.
openOptionsPage()voidhost

#Types

#OnInstalledReason

A string: "install", "update", "chrome_update", "shared_module_update". chrome.runtime.OnInstalledReason names them.

#PlatformOs

A string: "mac", "win", "android", "cros", "linux", "openbsd", "fuchsia". chrome.runtime.PlatformOs names them.

#ContextType

A string: "TAB", "POPUP", "BACKGROUND", "OFFSCREEN_DOCUMENT", "SIDE_PANEL", "DEVELOPER_TOOLS". chrome.runtime.ContextType names them.
